name: scene_a
prompt: Wide 16:9 night-time background for a premium cartoon slot machine game: FALCOS, a clean, friendly, well-kept American gas station and convenience store at night, freshly painted cream and red, bright and inviting, glowing white canopy lights, clean concrete, tidy planters, an ice machine, a propane cage, a 'snacks' style window poster without text. Not abandoned, not rusty, no litter. COMPOSITION (important, a game board will cover the middle 50% of the picture, so the story happens at the left and right edges): LEFT QUARTER: under the edge of the gas canopy, whose front fascia carries a big red neon script sign reading exactly "FALCOS" (F-A-L-C-O-S) glowing hot red; below it a modern gas pump with the nozzle plugged into the fuel door of a big black cartoon Chevy Tahoe SUV seen from its rear three-quarter, the SUV mostly cut off by the left edge of the frame; a cartoon white woman in her early thirties with long wavy blonde hair, oversized sunglasses pushed up on her head, a cropped white puffer jacket, leggings and white sneakers, leaning her back against the rear liftgate of the Tahoe with one foot up, relaxed, smoking a cigarette with a curl of smoke rising, her full body visible. RIGHT QUARTER: the store's big front window, warm-lit inside, showing a cartoon South Asian Indian man in his forties with a thick moustache, greying temples and a red FALCOS T-shirt, standing behind the counter at a cash register with the drawer open, smiling, handing change and a receipt across the counter to a customer whose arm is just visible; lottery tickets, a gum rack and a coffee machine around him. CENTRE: the store entrance and wall, calm and simple. Ground line about 88% down; wet clean concrete with soft reflections of the red neon and warm lights. Deep blue starry sky. STYLE: everything drawn as a polished high-end cartoon - characters with appealing stylised cartoon proportions (slightly larger heads, expressive faces), the Tahoe drawn as a chunky, slightly exaggerated cartoon car with bold shapes; bold confident black ink outlines with varied line weight, rich cel shading with soft gradients, clean saturated colours, crisp details, like a top-tier animated film background. Lighting: warm amber store and canopy light, cool night-blue fill, red neon glow from the FALCOS sign. No other readable text anywhere except the FALCOS sign and the FALCOS shirt.
